subject: Portfolio risk triage and QBR escalations - input needed
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio risk triage and QBR escalations - input needed

Team —

As part of next week's QBR prep I want to surface a short list of accounts that need exec attention and proposed mitigation steps. I started a working register (attached) with the things I could pull quickly. Please review and add/update by EOD today:

- Brightline — Renewal: 2028-09-15 (renewal motion fragile)
  - Symptoms: intermittent latency spikes, 35% drop in daily active sessions last 30d, finance flagged overrun on usage-based credits
  - Immediate ask: confirm whether we should budget a concession and who will own the renewal motion

- Zephyr Systems — Renewal: 2028-08-30 (legal still reviewing contract)
  - Symptoms: redlines on data residency clause, procurement requests additional SOC 2 evidence
  - Immediate ask: route to contracts/legal with priority; we may need a short addendum

- Acme — Renewal: 2028-10-01 (exec sponsor change)
  - Symptoms: new technical lead; usage is steady but NPS slipped after last release
  - Immediate ask: offer a technical health workshop and confirm sponsor alignment

Deliverables I need from each of you by EOD: updated risk row in the attached risk_register_july_v1.csv, one-sentence recommended executive ask (e.g., concession amount, legal escalation, on-site workshop), and any customer-facing comms you think we should use.

I will compile slides for execs Wednesday morning. If you think other accounts belong in this urgent bucket, add them (preferably with a proposed owner).

Thanks —
Dylan

Dylan Brooks
Senior Manager, Account Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: risk_register_july_v1.csv (CSV - 1 sheet, redlines column for asks)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio risk triage and QBR escalations - input needed

Dylan —

Thanks for kicking this off. I've updated the Brightline row in the CSV (see attached snapshot). Quick notes from ops and product metrics:

- Root cause: recent model rollout (v1.9.3) introduced a pathological memory pattern under specific prompt mix leading to KV cache thrashing; we've mitigated in the canary cluster but customer is on stable pool.
- Metrics (30d): latency p95 +210ms vs baseline, token success rate 98.3% -> 95.1% during spikes, DAU -35% for streaming endpoints only.
- Financial exposure: estimated overage of ~$32,000 this quarter if usage reverts; finance prefers a capped credit instead of blanket concession.

Recommended immediate asks:
- Offer a $50k capped concession (to appease procurement while keeping runway for negotiated commitment).
- Prioritize a hotfix backport to Brightline's stable pool this week and provide a postmortem by next Monday.

I'm available for a quick sync at 10:45 if you want to walk through the metrics.

Aditya
Product Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: brightline_health_snapshot.pdf (PDF - 5 pages, charts + incident timeline)

Forwarding to Brightline and looping in Rishi on the renewal motion. Sara — quick context: we observed a large latency spike last week tied to a model rollout. Aditya has attached the health snapshot; our recommended path is a capped concession plus urgent backport. Can you confirm: 1) Is Brightline open to a $50k capped credit in exchange for a 12-month committed minimum? 2) Can we schedule a 30-min technical call for tomorrow afternoon to review the hotfix plan?

Thanks for the heads up, Marissa. We saw the same spikes and it's impacting our customer-facing search product.

On the credit: procurement will need a written proposal and justification to take to finance; a $50k capped credit paired with a 12-month commit will likely be acceptable pending legal approval.

On the technical sync: we can do tomorrow at 2pm PT — I've put a placeholder on my calendar.

— Sara
Brightline, Head of Platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio risk triage and QBR escalations - input needed

Team —

Good work surfacing these. A few exec-level decisions and asks:

1) Brightline — authorize a $50,000 capped concession contingent on a signed 12-month committed minimum and a postmortem. Marissa, lead the renewal motion and coordinate the written proposal for procurement (Aditya, include the cost exposure numbers in the proposal).

2) Zephyr Systems — escalate to Contracts now. Contracts, please prioritize their data-residency redline and prepare a short addendum that limits liability while meeting their requirement. Notify me if you need an approval path or legal exceptions.

3) Acme — prioritize a technical health workshop and a one-slide exec summary for the QBR. Marissa, own scheduling.

4) QBR deliverable: I want a single slide per urgent account with: 1) one-line health status, 2) the executive ask (amount or action), 3) owner and CTA, 4) expected timeline to close. Send me the slides by Tuesday 9am PT; I'll consolidate into the exec pack.

I've attached a template exec asks doc I want used for each account. If anyone expects a deviation from the above, flag it now.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec_asks_summary.docx (DOCX - template: 1 slide per account)
